content:
An ordinary batch review creates one EXPORT lot and conversion quota. Its first release is spendable, while the remaining portion is held until the release event.

A classification-review batch can produce MARKET_B and SERVICE lots plus a delayed held portion. The total cash released does not identify its convertible share. The review response and subsequent lot records carry the actual source classifications and batch links.
